note: image x0 y0 x1 y1, top-left origin, right and bottom exclusive; each the building and a little context

PokeB_GameDomeLab.title: Domed lab
PokeB_GameDomeLab.drawn: The large building at the top left: two storeys under a flat red roof inside a parapet with a raised middle, a dome with a glazed band, fluted corner pilasters, a glass door under a sign.

PokeB_GameRedClinic.title: Red clinic
PokeB_GameRedClinic.drawn: The red-roofed building at the top middle: a white parapet, a skylight, dark corner pillars, a red portico over the door with a roundel on it, a sign, a tank and a dark teal window.

PokeB_GameGrayEntryHouse.title: Gray mansard house with a door
PokeB_GameGrayEntryHouse.drawn: The middle house: a grey mansard storey with two dormers and a chimney over tan boards on a stone base; a door up a stair, a window, a shallow bay.

PokeB_GameGrayWindowHouse.title: Gray mansard house with three windows
PokeB_GameGrayWindowHouse.drawn: The house to its right: the same mansard storey over brown boards with three windows and two shutters, no door on its front.

PokeB_GameCyanEntryHouse.title: Cyan mansard house
PokeB_GameCyanEntryHouse.drawn: The house at the bottom left: the middle house again, its mansard teal, its boards brown, its door orange.

PokeB_GameFlowerCottage.title: Flower cottage
PokeB_GameFlowerCottage.drawn: The cottage at the bottom right: cream walls, a bell-cast roof with two roof lights, flower boxes under the upper windows, a hooded door and bay, an outside stair on its right.
